title: DeepSeek V4 rumored as 1.6T-parameter MoE
summary: Reports attributed to a Princeton AI Lab fellow describe DeepSeek V4 as a 1.6T-parameter MoE model with sparse MQA, fused MoE kernels and hyperconnections, with leaked figures around 99.4% MMLU and 83.7% SWE-bench. Requires roughly a 512 GB-class machine to run locally even quantized.

research.notes: Unverified leak; benchmark numbers not independently confirmed.
